fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-10-30, the complainant paid Rs. 8,00,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-10-25 at about 13:15. The complainant, Dharani Shankar, provided the contact number 9000000003. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Hemanth Raj, using the number 9000000085.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, residential colony, afternoon, suspect, call detail, digital document, mobile number
